comment: Known differences between two canonical graph dumps (jets/rulesbench/graphdump), read by rules_bench_diff and embedded in it. A difference is unclassified unless an entry matches. Fields and pair kinds: README.md beside this file. Each entry names where the difference is recorded: a section of jets/rete/README.md or a register entry of projects/rules_benchmark. This built-in list holds only differences of the engine itself, which any workload can show; until the Go engine was retired (October 2026) they also covered the two engines against each other. An entry that names a workload's predicates, rules, members or files is kept in that workload's own list, passed with -known (README.md).

entries.description: The line is the same on both sides up to the label of a minted node, under a one-to-one correspondence of labels: the node is on both sides and was renamed because its neighbourhood within three hops differs. What differs is in its own lines, which are classified on their own.

Two doubles that differ in their last bits: an aggregate summed in another order, by the other engine or by the same engine in another run (sum_values over a set, an accumulation over rows that arrive in another order). At most 1e-7 quanta apart at the larger magnitude, about 3e-12 relative (a quantum is 2^-15 of it, graphdump.Quantum): a few ulps, and under a cent for any amount below a billion.
